fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Intercept Endpoint Group
fields.help: The endpoint group that this association is connected to, for example: 'projects/123456789/locations/global/interceptEndpointGroups/my-eg'.

fields.label: Intercept Endpoint Group Association ID
fields.help: The ID to use for the new association, which will become the final component of the endpoint group's resource name.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The cloud location of the association, currently restricted to 'global'.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: The VPC network that is associated.
